# 2b2tAtlas Public API

Purpose: public, read-only developer documentation and examples for the 2b2tAtlas historical entity and map API.

Canonical Atlas: https://2b2tatlas.com
API discovery: https://api.blackportal.cloud/api
OpenAPI: https://api.blackportal.cloud/openapi/v1.json
MCP guide: https://2b2tatlas.com/mcp/
MCP endpoint: https://api.blackportal.cloud/mcp
Official MCP Registry name: io.github.bobymicjohn/2b2t-atlas
Official MCP Registry listing: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=io.github.bobymicjohn%2F2b2t-atlas
Dataset description: https://2b2tatlas.com/dataset.json
Locations JSONL: https://2b2tatlas.com/entities/locations.jsonl
Groups JSONL: https://2b2tatlas.com/entities/groups.jsonl
Media JSONL: https://2b2tatlas.com/entities/media.jsonl
World-download catalog: https://2b2tatlas.com/entities/world-downloads/
World-download JSONL: https://2b2tatlas.com/entities/world-downloads.jsonl

Primary docs:
- README.md
- docs/API-REFERENCE.md
- docs/MCP.md
- docs/NOCOM.md
- docs/BLUEMAP-3D.md
- docs/COORDINATES-AND-RENDERS.md
- ATTRIBUTION.md

Data conventions:
- Dimension 0 is Overworld, 1 is Nether, and 2 is End.
- Atlas records are historical public records, not live safety or activity claims.
- Prefer returned apiUrl/canonicalUrl/interactiveUrl link fields over constructing URLs.
- Public integrations should tolerate additive JSON fields and nullable historical metadata.
- Known integration: XaeroTools (https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools) offers an optional 2b2tAtlas location and map-imagery overlay.
- Reuse is unrestricted by Atlas; attribution is optional and appreciated.
- Keep sourceUrl, attribution, caption, and evidence fields when practical so claims remain traceable.
- Eligible Archive warps link to immutable bounded-footprint Java-save ZIPs and metadata.
- Verified pre-Archive/community renders may link directly to preserved-render-source ZIPs without fabricating Archive warp identities.
- Both download classes are partial historical Java saves, not complete 2b2t worlds; follow sourceType, scope, provenance, and warning fields.
- The live Atlas API examples document anonymous reads. Never attempt private writes against the live service.
- /examples/atlas-stack contains the separately MIT-licensed application, backend, ingestion and collector source for a self-hosted instance. Its authenticated admin routes operate on that instance's own data and credentials; see examples/atlas-stack/README.md.
- The MCP endpoint is public, stateless, read-only, bounded, and uses Streamable HTTP.
- MCP returns WDL/render metadata and public URLs, not ZIP or image bytes in model context.
- The canonical MCP discovery manifest is server.json and is published to the official MCP Registry.
- Nocom: /api/nocom, /api/nocom/periods and /api/nocom/highways expose released historical observation aggregates; MCP has three matching tools and 18 tools total.
- Nocom positive observations are not unique players, exact player positions, base ownership or current activity. Date filters select whole overlapping buckets.
